title: First public release reaches every documentation recipient

criteria.acceptance_criterion: A new user completes the primary task from the README alone
criteria.statement: A new user, reading only the README, installs the tool and completes the primary task end to end without reading source.
criteria.hollow_delivery: The README is touched but a new user still cannot reach first success from it alone — or no README change lands at all.

check.actor: cold recipient (new user) equipped only with the README
check.procedure: Perform the install and the primary task following the README alone.
check.observable: The primary task completes end to end without reading source.
check.conforming_case: Install and first task succeed from the README's own steps.
check.falsifying_case: The user must read source or ask for a step the README omits.

criteria.acceptance_criterion: A contributor locates where the change lives and integrates against its documented contract
criteria.statement: A contributor, starting from the architecture docs, locates where the released surface lives and integrates against its documented signatures and errors without reverse-engineering the code.
criteria.hollow_delivery: Architecture and API docs are untouched or restate file names, so a contributor still reverse-engineers the code to integrate.

check.actor: cold recipient (contributor) starting from the architecture docs
check.procedure: Trace the released surface from the architecture docs and draft an integration call from the documented contract alone.
check.observable: The drafted call matches the documented signatures and errors without reading implementation.
check.conforming_case: The integration call is drafted from the documented contract and is accepted.
check.falsifying_case: The contributor reverse-engineers the code to find the surface or its errors.

criteria.acceptance_criterion: A discovery reader tells what the project is, who it is for, and why to choose it from the entry surface
criteria.statement: A reader who does not know the project exists tells, within the first few sentences of the entry surface, what it is, who it is for, and why to choose it over the status quo.
criteria.hollow_delivery: The entry surface leads with internals or borrowed prestige, so a discovery reader leaves without learning who it is for or why to choose it.

check.actor: cold recipient (discovery reader) reading the entry surface's opening
check.procedure: Read only the opening sentences and state the project's what, who, and why.
check.observable: All three are stated correctly from the opening alone.
check.conforming_case: The reader states what it is, who it is for, and why to choose it.
check.falsifying_case: The reader cannot say who it is for after the opening.
